fields.label: Page titles
fields.detail: Page-visible titles are omitted because they can reveal private activity.

fields.label: Hostnames
fields.detail: Hostnames are replaced with stable local correlation hashes.

fields.label: Filenames
fields.detail: Runtime filenames and display names are omitted.

fields.label: Full URLs
fields.detail: Full page and media URLs are replaced with redacted summaries.

fields.label: URL paths or hashes
fields.detail: Only path hashes and safe extension hints are retained.

fields.label: Query names
fields.detail: Query-parameter names are omitted; only a count may remain.

fields.label: Tokens or secret-shaped fields
fields.detail: Secret-shaped fields, credentials, and token-like diagnostic text are redacted.

fields.label: Queue history
fields.detail: Current queue evidence is redacted; persisted queue history is privacy-reduced and bounded by retention settings.

fields.label: Diagnostics
fields.detail: Bounded local strategy outcomes, error categories, and self-test results are included.

fields.label: Screenshots
fields.detail: Screenshots are not generated or included.

fields.label: Local paths
fields.detail: Drive, user-profile, home, temporary, and network paths are redacted.

fields.label: Browser or platform details
fields.detail: The extension version, manifest permissions, user agent, platform, and language are included.

fields.label: Blob identifiers
fields.detail: Page-local blob identifiers are always redacted.
